current_milestone.outcome: Phase 5 Web+n8n UX, demo launcher, screenshots and frozen evaluation protocol pass locally. Public candidate CI is pending; zero human sessions have occurred.

acceptance_evidence: All backend, frontend and container GitHub Actions jobs pass on the exact candidate commit.

Only after CI passes is PRODUCT_HARDENING added to completed_gates.
Human evaluation starts with the already frozen protocol and still reports zero sessions until real participants consent.

last_session.summary: Implemented and locally verified final Web+n8n UX, reproducible demo, screenshots and frozen dual-surface human-evaluation contract. Candidate public CI is pending; human sessions remain zero.
